messages:
Marta (Vendor): Hi Redwood team — sending invoice VND-9807 for March, total $22,400. PDF attached but it covers 2 POs. Link: https://invoices.vendorx.com/VND-9807 :paperclip:
Ravi (Finance): I only see one PO on the header, PO# 7788. Is there a second PO? We need both for auto-match.
Marta (Vendor): Our billing merged 7788 and 7790 into one file. Apologies.
Sasha (AP): That will fail our PO-match. Manual routing will add 7-10 business days. Can you reissue separate files per PO?
Marta (Vendor): We can split and re-send by EOD tomorrow. Alternatively, we can accept a temporary PO for immediate partial payment.
Diego (Procurement): We can raise TEMP-3310 to unblock payment for PO 7790 portion (~$6,500) if vendor signs acknowledgement.
Ravi (Finance): If TEMP PO used, we still need line-level GL and approver mapping. @Diego please confirm approver for 7790.
Diego (Procurement): 7790 -> GL 6050 (Cloud Infra) -> Approver: @Ravi. Vendor should include PO on line items.
Marta (Vendor): We'll sign the ack and include line-level PO refs on reissued files and file names like VND-9807_7790.pdf.
Paybot: Invoice VND-9807 attached for VendorX — amount $22,400 — status: pending_manual_review.
Sasha (AP): I'll place hold note: "VND-9807 awaiting split or TEMP-3310". Set follow-up 3 days.
Marta (Vendor): Thanks — signing now and will send split invoices tomorrow morning.
Ravi (Finance): Great, thanks everyone. Once TEMP-3310 is live or we have the split files, AP can proceed.
